scope: Mangalajodi birdwatching experience, photograph and portable reading
Founder byline, visible footnotes and exact returns
reader_gain: Gives a beginner a concrete way to observe outline, bill and movement, distinguish observations from inferred explanations, ask a guide useful questions and avoid disturbing birds.

checks.desktop: 1280x900 cover, readable narrative and visible notes inspected; full-frame photo and no horizontal overflow.
checks.mobile: 390x844 cover, narrative and notes inspected; readable line lengths, full-frame photo and no horizontal overflow.
checks.keyboard: Desktop Enter on habitat marker focused its note; return focused exact marker. Mobile ethics marker and return also transferred focus to the correct IDs.
checks.portable: Tests retain all four sections, every paragraph, concise source titles/URLs and user notes; full bibliographic notes stay on website.
checks.media: Existing Neerakiran photo inspected; date and CC BY-SA 4.0 credit retained. Full frame and unchanged SHA256 verified by test.
checks.regression: Full and coast suites pass. Initial full run had two stale test expectations: old caption wording and the formerly unreviewed experience byline. Updated those expectations; unreviewed stay and Kalijai experience remain protected.

limitations: Same-assistant review, not independent human or specialist review.
No field visit, bird count, current operator or equipment confirmation.
Observation exercises are suggestions, not invented field testimony.
General ABA guidance is not Odisha legislation.
Browser emulation, not physical-device or screen-reader testing.
